dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, what year are you in?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ˈjɪr ər juː ˈɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm in my second year. And you?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ɪn maɪ ˈsɛkənd ˈjɪr. ənd ˈjuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm a senior. It's my fourth year.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ə ˈsiːnjər. ɪts maɪ ˈfɔːrθ ˈjɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But it's your first year here!
dialogue.reading: bʌt ɪts jʊr ˈfɜːrst ˈjɪr ˈhɪr!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes! Here, I'm a freshman again!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ˈhɪr, aɪm ə ˈfrɛʃmən əˈɡɛn!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't worry. I can help you.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. aɪ kən ˈhɛlp juː.
